title: Rules used by the sample Excel template (reproduces the sample PDF exactly)
basis: Slab table and thresholds of the Finance Act 2024 structure (5% band, women Tk 4,00,000) with a flat Tk 5,000 minimum tax, exactly as the sample return was computed.
warning: This profile copies the sample template, which still uses the older slab table (5% band). Reports on AY 2026-27 say the 5% band was removed and thresholds were raised. Use it to reproduce the sample or when you have confirmed it is right for your case.
